text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Subculture enthusiast and info broker 
Transcend officially signed a contract 
with a Trainer who felt like a kindred 
spirit, and set into motion the 
preparations for her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
“Life is just a run-of-the-mill drama” 
that's utterly predictable. Yet, she says 
that a clash of pure earnestness allows 
you a glimpse of “what lies beyond 
imagination.”

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Searching for "something more thrilling 
than victory," Transcend's dirt track 
journey in the Twinkle Series has gently 
begun.
